title: Dedicated autoscaler: priority-aware burst controls & enhanced utilization reporting
author: Anjali Rao
description: Motivation: We need finer-grained burst controls that respect customer priority tiers (gold/silver/bronze) and improved utilization reporting to make capacity chargebacks and autoscaler decisions more transparent. This PR implements priority-aware burst tokens, adds token-bucket smoothing per-priority, surfaces new per-priority utilization metrics in the fleet reporting pipeline, and extends the Dedicated Console dashboards. Summary of changes: - Add priority token buckets and burst caps to the Dedicated autoscaler runtime. - Introduce smoothing window to reduce burst oscillation under transient traffic. - Emit new metrics: dedicated.autoscaler.priority.{tier}.burst_tokens, .burst_consumed, .smoothed_utilization, and .queueing_latency_p90. - Update reporting pipeline (aggregator + materialized views) to support per-priority slices and export CSV for billing. - Console updates: new per-priority charts, threshold alerts, and rollouts tab changes to surface priority fallbacks. Backward compatibility: The new priority logic is configurable and disabled by default for existing Dedicated fleets; admins can opt-in via fleet config priority_burst: enabled. Rollout plan: staged rollout — unit tests + staging e2e with synthetic load, canary on 5% of fleets for 48h, then full rollout. Linear tickets: ENG-4521, ENG-4680, PM-119. Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-4521) - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Staging perf validation - [x] Console changes behind feature flag - [x] Release notes drafted - [x] Docs PR opened (see linked PR) CI/validation notes: CI initially failed on linter (naming mismatch) and one flaky autoscaler integration test; addressed in follow-up commits. Observability: added debug logs gated behind debug_priority_burst=true. Migration notes: existing stored metrics remain unchanged; new metric names are additive. Related work: builds on prior tokenbucket smoothing work (PRs: pr-216900-dedicated-autoscaler-burst-smoothing-util-reporting.json) and fleet autoscaler reporting refactors.
commit_summary: add priority-aware tokenbucket and burst caps; implement smoothing window and per-priority metrics; update aggregator and materialized views; console charts for priority slices; fix linting and test flakiness
review_comments: Liam O'Connor: The per-priority token refill rate calculation looks correct but please add a unit test covering the edge case where multiple priorities are draining tokens simultaneously. Also ensure the metric cardinality is bounded.

Anjali Rao: Added a test for concurrent drains and introduced a normalization step to cap cardinality (see tokenbucket.go). Updated the PR description with metric names and ensured all new metrics use fixed label sets.
Sofia Martinez: Console changes look good. Minor nit: rename 'smoothed_util' to 'smoothed_utilization' for clarity so dashboards match metric names.
Anjali Rao: Renamed metric and updated console bindings. CI reran and passed.

tests_and_validation: Unit: 92 new tests added covering tokenbucket, smoothing, and metric emission
Integration: priority_burst_e2e_test validated with synthetic load (staging) — no regressions observed
Load: staging run @ 4k req/s with prioritized workload showing 18% lower 95th latency for gold tier under burst compared to baseline
rollout_notes: Feature gated behind fleet config (priority_burst.enabled = true). Canary rollout strategy: enable for 5% fleets for 48h, monitor dedicated.autoscaler.priority.* metrics + queueing_latency_p90 and error_rate. If metrics stable, ramp to 50% then 100% over 72h.
release_notes: Add priority-aware burst controls to Dedicated autoscaler (opt-in). New per-priority metrics and dashboard views to help teams understand burst consumption and smoothed utilization. Backwards compatible when disabled.
